verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: Ta tekna hypakouete tois goneusin hymōn en Kyriō touto gar estin dikaion
verses.literal: Children obey your parents in the Lord for this is right

verses.original: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Tima ton patera sou kai tēn mētera hētis estin entolē prōtē en epangelia
verses.literal: Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise)

verses.original: Ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Hina eu soi genētai kai esē makrochronios epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi pateres mē parorgizete ta tekna hymōn alla ektrephete auta en paideia kai nouthesia Kyriou
verses.literal: Fathers do not provoke your children to wrath instead bring them up . . . in the discipline and instruction of the Lord

verses.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoi douloi hypakouete tois kata sarka kyriois meta phobou kai tromou en haplotēti tēs kardias hymōn hōs tō Christō
verses.literal: Slaves obey your earthly . . . masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart just as you would obey Christ

verses.original: μὴ κατ’ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλ’ ὡς δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκ ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: mē kat’ ophthalmodoulian hōs anthrōpareskoi all’ hōs douloi Christou poiountes to thelēma tou Theou ek psychēs
verses.literal: And do this not only to please them while they are watching but as servants of Christ doing the will of God from your heart

verses.original: μετ’ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: met’ eunoias douleuontes hōs tō Kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois
verses.literal: Serve with good will as to the Lord and not to men

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἕκαστος ἐάν τι ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν τοῦτο κομίσεται παρὰ Κυρίου εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti hekastos ean ti poiēsē agathon touto komisetai para Kyriou eite doulos eite eleutheros
verses.literal: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does whether he is slave or free

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρ’ αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi kyrioi ta auta poieite pros autous anientes tēn apeilēn eidotes hoti kai autōn kai hymōn ho Kyrios estin en ouranois kai prosōpolēmpsia ouk estin par’ autō
verses.literal: And masters do the same . . . for your slaves Give up your use of threats because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven and there is no favoritism with Him

verses.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tou loipou endynamousthe en Kyriō kai en tō kratei tēs ischyos autou
verses.literal: Finally be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power

verses.original: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδείας τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: endysasthe tēn panoplian tou Theou pros to dynasthai hymas stēnai pros tas methodeias tou diabolou
verses.literal: Put on the full armor of God so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ σκότους τούτου πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: hoti ouk estin hēmin hē palē pros haima kai sarka alla pros tas archas pros tas exousias pros tous kosmokratoras tou skotous toutou pros ta pneumatika tēs ponērias en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood but against the rulers against the authorities against the powers of this world’s darkness and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι
verses.transliteration: Dia touto analabete tēn panoplian tou Theou hina dynēthēte antistēnai en tē hēmera tē ponēra kai hapanta katergasamenoi stēnai
verses.literal: Therefore take up the full armor of God so that when the day of evil comes you will be able to stand your ground and having done everything to stand

verses.original: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: stēte oun perizōsamenoi tēn osphyn hymōn en alētheia kai endysamenoi ton thōraka tēs dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: Stand firm then with the belt of truth buckled around your waist with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed

verses.original: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: kai hypodēsamenoi tous podas en hetoimasia tou euangeliou tēs eirēnēs
verses.literal: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace

verses.original: ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ πονηροῦ τὰ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι
verses.transliteration: en pasin analabontes ton thyreon tēs pisteōs en hō dynēsesthe panta ta belē tou ponērou ta pepyrōmena sbesai
verses.literal: In addition to all this take up the shield of faith with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one

verses.original: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου δέξασθε καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ Πνεύματος ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai tēn perikephalaian tou sōtēriou dexasthe kai tēn machairan tou Pneumatos ho estin rhēma Theou
verses.literal: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit which is the word of God

verses.original: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν Πνεύματι καὶ εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: dia pasēs proseuchēs kai deēseōs proseuchomenoi en panti kairō en Pneumati kai eis auto agrypnountes en pasē proskarterēsei kai deēsei peri pantōn tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: Pray in the Spirit at all times with every kind of prayer and petition To this end stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: kai hyper emou hina moi dothē logos en anoixei tou stomatos mou en parrēsia gnōrisai to mystērion tou euangeliou
verses.literal: Pray also for me that whenever I open my mouth words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel

verses.original: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hyper hou presbeuō en halysei hina en autō parrēsiasōmai hōs dei me lalēsai
verses.literal: for which I am an ambassador in chains Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly . . . . . . as I should

verses.original: Ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ κατ’ ἐμέ τί πράσσω πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hina de eidēte kai hymeis ta kat’ eme ti prassō panta gnōrisei hymin Tychikos ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos en Kyriō
verses.literal: Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord will tell you everything so that you also may know about me and what I am doing

verses.original: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hon epempsa pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē tas kardias hymōn
verses.literal: I have sent him to you for this very purpose that you may know about us and that he may encourage your hearts

verses.original: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eirēnē tois adelphois kai agapē meta pisteōs apo Theou Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hē charis meta pantōn tōn agapōntōn ton Kyrion hēmōn Iēsoun Christon en aphtharsia
verses.literal: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love
